headline: South Africa Regulator Blacklists Moriel Infrastructure Over Capability Concerns
summary: South Africa's Construction Industry Development Board removed Moriel Infrastructure Group from its contractor register following an investigation into the firm's financial and technical capabilities.
why: The Construction Industry Development Board oversees contractor standards and eligibility for public infrastructure projects in South Africa.

impacts.name: Moriel Infrastructure Group
impacts.why: Removal from the national contractor register disqualifies the firm from bidding on registered projects.
